title: Hostinger Review 2026: Speed, Pricing & True Performance Tested
summary: We tested Hostinger's LiteSpeed servers for 365 days. Here's why it remains our #1 recommendation for beginners and growing businesses.
cons: No phone support (24/7 live chat only)
Dedicated IP only on Business & Cloud tiers
body: Hostinger offers the single best price-to-performance ratio in the web hosting industry. Backed by LiteSpeed servers, custom hPanel, and free domains, it outperforms hosts costing three times as much.
